```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

with open("content/training.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

hero = data.get("hero", {})
section = data.get("section", {})
resources = data.get("resources", [])

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def render_resource(resource, index):

    title = safe(resource.get("title"))
    description = safe(resource.get("description"))
    button = safe(resource.get("button_label"))
    url = safe(resource.get("url"))

    return f"""
    <article class="cw-training-card">

      <div class="cw-training-card-number">
        {index:02d}
      </div>

      <div class="cw-training-card-content">

        <h3>{title}</h3>

        <p>{description}</p>

        <div class="cw-training-card-footer">
          <a
            href="{url}"
            class="cw-training-button"
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
          >
            {button}
            <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
          </a>
        </div>

      </div>

    </article>
    """

cards = "".join(
    render_resource(resource, index)
    for index, resource in enumerate(resources, start=1)
)

html = f"""
<div class="cw-training">

  <section class="cw-training-hero">

    <div class="cw-training-hero-content">

      <span class="cw-training-eyebrow">
        {safe(hero.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h1>{safe(hero.get("title"))}</h1>

      <p>{safe(hero.get("description"))}</p>

    </div>

  </section>

  <section class="cw-training-resources">

    <div class="cw-training-section-heading">

      <span class="cw-training-section-label">
        {safe(section.get("eyebrow"))}
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(section.get("title"))}</h2>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-training-grid">
      {cards}
    </div>

  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))
```
